_comment: A backstop, not the control. The control is that the container stays
closed during a session and the kit lives on a different branch of the
filesystem than the data. See CLAUDE.md.
Deny is scoped to the two data directories rather than to all of
translation-work/. docs/ holds the reference manuals, contains no case
material, and every document in the set states that Claude Code may
read it -- denying the whole parent made that statement false.
_shared/ is inside the denied tree and stays denied: reaching it at all
would require the container mounted, which the guard already forbids
during a session, so an 'ask' rule there was unreachable either way.
grep and rg are listed because CLAUDE.md names Grep, by name, as a route
by which document content enters a session -- a scoping pass had dropped
the grep rule without replacing it. These are prefix-matched command
patterns and will not catch every spelling; they are a backstop, and the
reason they are not the control is written at the top of this comment.
